dedupe_keys.name: israel airports authority flight database arrivals and departures updated every 15 minutes

description: The Israel Airports Authority publishes its live flight database on the national open data portal. Contents: scheduled and actual arrivals and departures at Israeli international airports, mainly Ben Gurion, with airline code and name, flight number, scheduled and updated times, terminal, check-in counters, origin or destination city and country, and status (landed, departed, delayed, cancelled and so on). Producer: the Israel Airports Authority from its flight information display system. Coverage: current and near-term flights at Israeli airports; the file is a rolling snapshot, refreshed about every 15 minutes, not an archive; it held 3,353 flights on 29 September 2026. Format and access: a CSV resource on data.gov.il that is also served through the CKAN datastore API, so it can be polled programmatically. Free under the portal's open terms. Caveats: historical flights drop out of the file, so building a time series means collecting snapshots over time; status wording is in Hebrew and English; security-related disruptions can change schedules at short notice. Simulation uses: airport operations and disruption monitoring, delay and cancellation statistics during crises, and inputs to passenger flow or ground access models for Ben Gurion airport. Related records: the Ministry of Transport planning layers (data-israel-ministry-of-transport-planning-gis-layers) cover the rail and road access network.
